license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine in this state without holding a license or permit to do so, as provided in this article.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" refers to the medical licensing board of Indiana.

name.quote: The medical licensing board of Indiana is created.

type.quote: The medical licensing board of Indiana is created. It shall consist of seven (7) members

umbrella_agency.quote: "Agency" refers to the Indiana professional licensing agency under IC 25-1-5.

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant must not have a conviction for a crime that has a direct bearing on the applicant's ability to practice competently.

degree_required.value: Doctor of Medicine or Doctor of Osteopathy or its equivalent from a board-approved medical school
degree_required.quote: The applicant shall possess the degree of doctor of medicine or doctor of osteopathy or its equivalent from a medical school which was approved by the board as of the time the degree was conferred.

accrediting_body.value: Board-approved medical school (nationally accredited college of medicine or of osteopathic medicine)
accrediting_body.quote: "Medical school" means a nationally accredited college of medicine or of osteopathic medicine approved by the board.

degree_level.quote: The applicant shall possess the degree of doctor of medicine or doctor of osteopathy or its equivalent

school_approval_basis.quote: a medical school which was approved by the board as of the time the degree was conferred

credential_pegged.quote: The applicant shall possess the degree of doctor of medicine or doctor of osteopathy or its equivalent from a medical school which was approved by the board

required.quote: The applicant shall have completed one (1) year of postgraduate training in a hospital or institution located in the United States, its possessions, or Canada that meets standards set by the board

experience_source.quote: The applicant shall have completed one (1) year of postgraduate training in a hospital or institution located in the United States, its possessions, or Canada that meets standards set by the board under IC 25-22.5-2-7.

duration.quote: The applicant shall have completed one (1) year of postgraduate training

kind.value: postgraduate training in a hospital or institution
kind.quote: one (1) year of postgraduate training in a hospital or institution located in the United States, its possessions, or Canada

exams.name: Examination for Licensure (USMLE or equivalent)
exams.notes: Board adopts rules concerning examinations and may approve national examinations. For endorsement, a passing score on an equivalent examination in another state or given by a recognized certifying agency is accepted. The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact references the USMLE and COMLEX.
exams.quote: An applicant must achieve a passing score on the examination to qualify for licensure.

interval_years.quote: a license issued under this article expires biennially on the date established by the licensing agency under IC 25-1-5-4

available.quote: The board in its discretion may register as a physician and may issue by endorsement an unlimited license to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine to any applicant who has complied with the minimum requirements of IC 25-22.5-3; and passed an examination for licensure in another state or territory of the United States, or Canada

requirements.value: Must comply with minimum requirements (degree, postgraduate training, character); must have passed an equivalent examination in another state/territory/Canada or by a recognized certifying agency approved by the board.
requirements.quote: complied with the minimum requirements of IC 25-22.5-3 ; and passed an examination for licensure in another state or territory of the United States, or Canada; or given by a recognized certifying agency approved by the board; if that examination was, in the opinion of the board, equivalent in every respect to Indiana's examination at the time it was taken.

credential_type.quote: is entitled to be registered as a physician and to receive an unlimited license to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine.

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine in this state without holding a license or permit to do so, as provided in this article.

title_protection.quote: Attaching to a name, either alone or in connection with other words, the designation or term: "doctor of medicine"; "M.D."; "doctor of osteopathy"; "D.O."; "physician"

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine in this state without holding a license or permit to do so, as provided in this article.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing with an expired medical license.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing office based anesthesia without the proper accreditation.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to perform duties required for issuing birth or death certificates.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to disclose or negligent omission of documentation requested for licensure renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to disclose, or negligent omission of, documentation requested for licensure renewal.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to complete or timely transmit a pregnancy termination form
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to complete or timely transmit a pregnancy termination form under IC 16-34-2-5 , with each failure constituting a separate violation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physician knowingly participated in cloning or attempted cloning
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board shall revoke the license of a physician if, after appropriate notice and an opportunity for a hearing, the attorney general proves by a preponderance of the evidence that the physician knowingly participated in cloning or attempted cloning.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to transmit required pregnancy termination report to Indiana Department of Health
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board may revoke the license of a physician if, after appropriate notice and an opportunity for a hearing, the attorney general proves by a preponderance of the evidence that the physician failed to transmit the form to the Indiana department of health as described in IC 16-34-2-5(b)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physician performed an abortion in violation of specified statutes with intent to avoid requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: shall revoke the license of a physician if, after appropriate notice and an opportunity for a hearing, the attorney general proves by a preponderance of the evidence that the physician performed an abortion in violation of IC 16-34-2-7(a) through IC 16-34-2-7(c) with the intent to avoid the requirements of IC 16-34-2-1.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physician permits or authorizes filling/refilling a legend drug prescription except as authorized
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A physician licensed in Indiana who permits or authorizes a person to fill or refill a prescription or drug order for a legend drug except as authorized in IC 16-42-19-11 through IC 16-42-19-19 is subject to disciplinary action under IC 25-1-9.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant had disciplinary action taken against them or their license by the board or another state's licensing agency due to inability to safely practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant shall not have had disciplinary action taken against the applicant or the applicant's license by the board or by the licensing agency of any other state or jurisdiction by reasons of the applicant's inability to safely practice medicine or osteopathic medicine

definition_quote.value: "Practice of medicine or osteopathic medicine" means any one (1) or a combination of the following: (1) Holding oneself out to the public as being engaged in: (A) the diagnosis, treatment, correction, or prevention of any disease, ailment, defect, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain, or other condition of human beings; (B) the suggestion, recommendation, or prescription or administration of any form of treatment, without limitation; (C) the performing of any kind of surgical operation upon a human being...; or (D) the prevention of any physical, mental, or functional ailment or defect of any person.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of medicine or osteopathic medicine" means any one (1) or a combination of the following: (1) Holding oneself out to the public as being engaged in: (A) the diagnosis, treatment, correction, or prevention of any disease, ailment, defect, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain, or other condition of human beings

value: prevention of disease, ailment, defect, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain, or other condition
prescription or administration of any form of treatment
surgical operations (including use of mechanical means, laser, or ionizing radiation)
methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis, treatment, correction, or prevention of any disease, ailment, defect, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain, or other condition of human beings; (B) the suggestion, recommendation, or prescription or administration of any form of treatment, without limitation; (C) the performing of any kind of surgical operation upon a human being

drug_authority.value: Licensed physicians may prescribe, direct, order, or designate the use of drugs and medicines in accordance with IC 25-1-9.3; subject to rules on controlled substances and opioid prescribing.
drug_authority.quote: "Prescribe or prescription" means to direct, order, or designate the use of or manner of using a drug, medicine, or treatment, by spoken or written words or other means and in accordance with IC 25-1-9.3.

license_status_types.quote: Issue an unlimited license, a limited license, or a temporary medical permit, depending upon the qualifications of the applicant

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must complete a minimum of two years of postgraduate training in a US or Canadian hospital approved by nationally recognized medical accrediting bodies (board may waive second year). Alternatively, may qualify for a noneducational ECFMG certified graduate permit for training in Indiana under supervision.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: an applicant for licensure who has been graduated from a medical school outside the United States, its possessions, or Canada; and submits evidence satisfactory to the board that prior to passing the examination the applicant has successfully completed a minimum of at least two (2) years of postgraduate training in a hospital or an institution located in the United States or Canada

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: The applicant shall have completed one (1) year of postgraduate training in a hospital or institution located in the United States, its possessions, or Canada that meets standards set by the board

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: The medical licensing board shall adopt rules establishing standards and protocols for prescribing controlled substances; rules on conditions exempted from opioid prescription limitations under IC 25-1-9.7-2; rules on appropriate prescribing of Schedule III or IV controlled substances for weight reduction or obesity; and board must adopt rules on conditions exempt from prescribing limitations set forth in IC 25-1-9.7-2(a).
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: The medical licensing board of Indiana shall, in consultation with the Indiana department of health, the office of the secretary of family and social services, and representatives of prescriber stakeholders, adopt rules under IC 4-22-2 setting forth the conditions the board considers necessary under IC 25-1-9.7-2(b)(1)(D) to be exempted from the prescribing limitations set forth in IC 25-1-9.7-2(a).

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: "INSPECT program" means the Indiana scheduled prescription electronic collection and tracking program established by IC 25-1-13-4.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: The board may adopt rules under IC 4-22-2 establishing guidelines for the practice of telehealth in Indiana. Telehealth diagnostic or treatment services transmitted through electronic communications on a regular, routine, and nonepisodic basis or under an oral or written agreement constitute the practice of medicine. A nonresident physician outside Indiana does not practice medicine in Indiana by providing a second opinion or follow-up diagnostic/treatment services.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: The board may adopt rules under IC 4-22-2 establishing guidelines for the practice of telehealth in Indiana. Adoption of rules under this subsection may not delay the implementation and provision of telehealth services by a provider under IC 25-1-9.5.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: In order to strengthen access to health care, and in recognition of the advances in the delivery of health care, the member states of the interstate medical licensure compact have allied in common purpose

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: "Physician assistant" means an individual who: (1) has a collaborative agreement with a physician

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: The applicant shall be physically and mentally capable of, and professionally competent to, safely engage in the practice of medicine or osteopathic medicine as determined by the board and shall submit: (1) to an examination; or (2) additional evidence to the board; if considered necessary by the board to determine such capability.

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: A person who holds a valid license to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine in the United States, its possessions, or Canada, and who is seeking licensure by endorsement, may be issued a temporary medical permit by the agency upon the authorization of the board. A temporary medical permit issued under this subsection is valid for ninety (90) days

investigational_drug_protection.quote: This section does not create a cause of action against a health care provider involved in connection with the use of an investigational drug, biological product, or device by a patient for any harm to the patient from the investigational drug, biological product, or device.

scope__license_status_types.quote: Any physician licensed to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine in this state who intends to become inactive in the practice of medicine or osteopathic medicine shall notify the board in writing... The board shall then classify the physician's license as inactive.

Any physician licensed to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine in this state who intends to retire from practice shall notify the board in writing of the physician's intention to retire. Upon receipt of this notice, the board shall record the fact that the physician is retired
The board may authorize the agency to issue temporary medical permits for the practice of medicine or osteopathic medicine.
The board may: (1) refuse to issue a license; (2) issue an unlimited license; or (3) issue a probationary license to an applicant for licensure by examination or endorsement
the board may sue to enjoin the accused from practicing medicine or osteopathic medicine until the hearing

the board shall revoke the license of a physician if, after appropriate notice and an opportunity for a hearing, the attorney general proves by a preponderance of the evidence that the physician knowingly participated in cloning or attempted cloning.

If any disciplinary proceedings under this chapter are pending against a physician, the physician may not surrender or retire the physician's license to practice without the written approval of the board.

A medical educational institution located in Indiana which has standards satisfactory to the board may, in the board's discretion, secure from it a permit for a person in the active practice of medicine outside the state of Indiana or the United States, but who is not licensed in Indiana, to teach medicine in the institution
"Expedited license" means a full and unrestricted medical license granted by a member state to an eligible physician through the process set forth in the compact.

A temporary medical permit issued to a person under this subsection for purposes of postgraduate training is valid for a period of one (1) year and may be renewed for additional one (1) year periods at the discretion of the board.

A person who is licensed to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine by any board or licensing agency of another state or jurisdiction, and who meets the requirements established by the board under IC 25-22.5-2-7, may be issued a temporary medical permit limited by terms and conditions considered appropriate by the board. A temporary medical permit issued under this subsection is valid for a nonrenewable period of no more than thirty (30) days.
